synthesis.summary_id: IHSG melemah 0,92% dan BTC terkoreksi 6,3%, sementara USD/IDR dan emas relatif stabil. Sektor perbankan masih solid, namun volatilitas aset berisiko menuntut batas rugi ketat.
synthesis.summary_en: Markets mixed: IHSG slips 0.92% and BTC drops 6.3%, while USD/IDR and gold hold steady. Banking fundamentals remain resilient, but elevated risk-asset volatility warrants strict stop limits.
synthesis.key_risk_alert_id: Koreksi BTC 6,3% dan pelemahan IHSG 0,92% memicu rezim waspada; perketat ukuran posisi dan cadangan kas.
synthesis.key_risk_alert_en: BTC 6.3% drawdown and IHSG 0.92% dip trigger cautious regime; tighten position sizing and cash buffers.
